races.paceDynamic: No Knee Never will take them along as the sole confirmed front runner, with possible support from Alazwar and Sassy Glory if they show early. The lack of natural pace pressure means No Knee Never can dictate comfortable fractions through the early stages before the field bunches up turning for home. With 10 of 13 runners showing hold-up tendencies, this creates a bunched finish where positioning and a clear run become crucial. This tactical setup strongly favours the prominent racers who can track the pace and kick clear before the hold-up brigade gets organized.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Dictates Comfortably
scenarios.trigger: If No Knee Never gets soft fractions and isn't pressured early
scenarios.body: The front runner can maintain the advantage while prominent racers like Alazwar get first run on the field. The hold-up horses struggle to make up ground from too far back in a race run at a manageable tempo.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Acceleration
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens significantly from the 4-furlong pole
scenarios.body: Early leaders tire and the race becomes a sprint finish between hold-up horses with the best turn of foot. Those who can quicken off a strong pace gain the advantage.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Messy Bunch Finish
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses challenge simultaneously in the straight
scenarios.body: The large field of hold-up horses creates traffic problems and interference issues. Luck in running and jockey strength become decisive factors in a scrambled finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop
scenarios.trigger: If Alazwar or Sassy Glory pressure No Knee Never throughout
scenarios.body: The honest pace finds out the stamina-doubtful runners over this extended trip. Horses with proven staying ability and fitness come to the fore late.

watchPoints.text: No Knee Never must be watched for early pressure as any serious challenge to the lead changes the entire race dynamic
Book Of Life and Pessoa both need clear runs in straight as hold-up horses in large field with amateur jockeys
Volendam's recent course win makes him dangerous if getting good position from hold-up style
Alazwar's prominent style could see her taken on early which may compromise her finishing kick
Wyvern's perfect 15/15 course record suggests track specialist who knows how to win here

races.paceDynamic: Wonderful Wendy will take this field along from the front with no other confirmed early pace in the race. The moderate gallop she sets will allow the prominent runners Semele and Exquisite Skye to sit close, while the hold-up horses Electric Arc, Littlecote, Noble Grace and Six Blue will be positioned further back. Without pressure on the leader, this becomes a tactical affair where positioning and timing matter more than raw pace. This race shape strongly favours the prominent runners and potentially the leader, as the hold-up horses will face the difficult task of making up ground in a slowly-run race.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Wonderful Wendy sets a steady pace without pressure from the field
scenarios.body: The prominent runners Semele and Exquisite Skye can travel easily behind the leader and have first run on the field when the pace quickens. Hold-up horses struggle to make up the deficit in a tactical finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Class Shows Late
scenarios.trigger: If the higher-rated Electric Arc or Noble Grace produce their best form despite unfavourable pace
scenarios.body: Their superior ability allows them to overcome the tactical disadvantage and power home despite giving the front division a start. The pace scenario doesn't favour them but class can trump tactics.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Leader Lasts Home
scenarios.trigger: If Wonderful Wendy's moderate ability is masked by an uncontested lead and soft fractions
scenarios.body: She builds an unassailable advantage while the field sleeps, and her rivals leave their challenges too late. The tactical race plays perfectly into her hands despite her low rating.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes exceptionally slow and creates a bunched finish
scenarios.body: The entire field remains in contention entering the straight, leading to a cavalry charge finish where any horse can win. Jockey positioning and horse acceleration become crucial in the final furlong.

watchPoints.text: Wonderful Wendy builds an unassailable lead if allowed to dictate fractions unopposed from the front
Electric Arc and Noble Grace need the pace to develop strongly to showcase their superior ratings from hold-up positions
Semele and Exquisite Skye are perfectly positioned tactically if they can sit close to the uncontested leader
The absence of early pace apart from Wonderful Wendy could create a tactical stalemate that favours front-runners
Littlecote's hold-up style faces a significant disadvantage without genuine pace pressure on the leader

races.paceDynamic: Epictetus and City Of God will dispute the early lead, with Epictetus likely to establish a slight advantage given Saffie Osborne's tactical awareness. The presence of prominent runners Lordsbridge Blu, Renesmee, and Newfangled should ensure the pace doesn't become overly quick, creating a solid but manageable gallop. The long Wolverhampton straight allows hold-up horses to mount challenges, but the consistent tempo should prevent a complete collapse. This race shape strongly favours the prominent/handy horses who can track the leaders without being caught too deep, particularly those with proven finishing kicks at this venue.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is solid but not excessive, allowing handy horses to position perfectly
scenarios.body: The front two will soften each other up while prominent trackers save energy for the straight. Lordsbridge Blu, Renesmee, and Newfangled are perfectly positioned to strike in the final two furlongs.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Leader Gets Away
scenarios.trigger: If Epictetus or City Of God secures an uncontested lead with the other settling behind
scenarios.body: The loose leader builds an unassailable advantage while the field fails to organize an effective pursuit. Epictetus has the class edge and recent form to capitalize on such a scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Victory
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuinely strong between the two leaders
scenarios.body: The front runners collapse dramatically in the final furlong, opening the door for the closers. Big Sip and Echalar have the finishing speed to capitalize if given enough pace to aim at.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Special
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go too slow and it becomes a sprint from halfway
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical crawl before exploding into a dash, suiting those with the best turn of foot regardless of position. This would be chaotic and hard to predict with form going out the window.

scenarios.body: She can dictate comfortable fractions and prove hard to peg back in the straight. The lack of early pace pressure allows her superior tactical position to overcome the class deficit against lightly-raced rivals.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses contest the early lead creating unsustainable fractions throughout.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery where stamina and track position matter more than pure ability. Tactical speed becomes crucial in a slowly-run affair that suits none ideally.
